name: yopass
description: Yopass shares passwords, secrets and small files through links that expire and can be opened only once. Paste the secret, send the link, done: the recipient needs no account. Secrets are encrypted in the browser before they are uploaded, and the key stays in the link, so the server only ever stores ciphertext. This image adds a built-in Memcached, so secrets live in RAM only: nothing is written to disk, and a container restart deletes all open secrets. Yopass needs HTTPS: browsers only allow the encryption on https:// pages (or on localhost). Put it behind your reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik, Zoraxy, ...). It works on its own domain or under a path such as https://example.com/yopass/. Over plain http:// :1337 the page only shows a notice.

ports.name: WebUI port
ports.description: Web UI and API, plain HTTP. Point your reverse proxy with HTTPS at this port.

variables.name: Default expiry
variables.description: Expiry pre-selected in the form: 1 hour, 1 day or 1 week.

variables.name: One-time only
variables.description: true = every secret can be opened only once (users cannot untick One-time download).

variables.name: Hide one-click link
variables.description: true = the result page offers only the short link and the key, to send through two different channels (for example mail and phone).

variables.name: Imprint URL
variables.description: Optional link to your imprint / legal notice, shown in the footer.

variables.name: Privacy notice URL
variables.description: Optional link to your privacy notice, shown in the footer.

variables.name: Max file size
variables.description: Largest upload, for example 512KB or 1MB. 1MB is the maximum without a Yopass license.

variables.name: Max secret size
variables.description: Largest encrypted text secret in bytes.

variables.name: Argon2
variables.description: true = derive keys with Argon2id (stronger against guessing custom passwords). If your reverse proxy sets its own Content-Security-Policy, it must allow 'wasm-unsafe-eval'.

variables.name: Hide features section
variables.description: true = hide the feature list below the form.

variables.name: Trusted proxies
variables.description: Comma-separated IPs or CIDRs of your reverse proxy, so the logs show the real client address from X-Forwarded-For.

variables.name: Memcached memory (MB)
variables.description: RAM for the built-in Memcached that holds the secrets. At least 16.

variables.name: Database
variables.description: memcached = the built-in one (default) or an external one set below. redis = an external Redis, set the Redis URL.

variables.name: Memcached address
variables.description: 127.0.0.1:11211 = the built-in Memcached. Any other host:port uses an external Memcached instead.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Only with Database = redis, for example redis://192.168.1.10:6379/0.

variables.name: License key
variables.description: Optional Yopass business license (OIDC login, branding, read receipts, larger files).
